sourceReadingRule: Only explicit readScope is asserted self-read; unavailable full text remains incomplete. Original caches ignored by Git.

sources.title: Olga Kaminska: European Social Survey weighting data, v1.2 (6 July 2023)
sources.readScope: Entire 15-page guide; claims especially section 3 p.4 and sections 4.1–4.3 pp.5–9 (printed numbering).
sources.limits: General ESS guidance, not complete ESS11 DE sampling design; weights cannot eliminate all nonresponse error.

sources.title: ESS Round 11 country documentation report, edition 04
sources.readScope: Selected German fieldwork entries pp.79–81 and sample/frame/region statements pp.82–86, especially federal-state representativity warning p.86. Not every German metadata entry or other country chapter read.
sources.limits: Report is not the complete German sample-design protocol and is not evidence of datafile edition 4.2 by itself.

sources.title: Tihomir Asparouhov: Sampling Weights in Latent Variable Modeling
sources.readScope: Weighted Least Squares pp.421–423; Stratified Cluster Sampling pp.424–425; Factor Analysis with Cluster Sampling pp.425–426.
sources.limits: Selected original sections only; binary illustrative designs are not ESS validation, no ESS-specific loading/fit/sample-size cutoff established.

sources.title: Mplus User Guide v8, Chapter 15: VARIABLE command
sources.readScope: Full STRATIFICATION, CLUSTER and WEIGHT sections; allowed estimators and normalization of sampling weights.
sources.limits: Documented interface only; no executable/version/license observed. No claim of exact PPS inference or replicate-weight support from this read.

sources.title: Mplus User Guide v8, Chapter 16: ANALYSIS command
sources.readScope: EFA section and available-estimator table; WLSMV estimator description; DELTA/THETA; full RSTARTS and DIFFTEST sections.
sources.limits: Only specified sections self-read. Combination must receive synthetic executable smoke and identification review. DIFFTEST requires appropriate nested model inputs.

sources.title: Mplus User Guide v8, Chapter 1
sources.readScope: Full overview, especially Modeling with Missing Data and simulation overview.
sources.limits: WLS missingness restriction narrower than general MAR; does not validate the proposed complete-mask estimand or any ESS missingness assumptions.

sources.title: lavaan tutorial: Categorical data
sources.readScope: Entire short categorical tutorial, including ordered/WLSMV and absent categorical FIML.
sources.limits: Does not establish complete ESS stratification plus PSU correction. No R executable found.

sources.title: lavaan version history 0.7 series
sources.readScope: Full short version-history page, especially 0.7-2 release dated 16 July 2026 and WLS sampling-weight covariance support.
sources.limits: Current individual capabilities do not imply all needed design combinations; no runtime smoke.

sources.title: Winnie Wing-Yee Tse, Mark H. C. Lai and Yichi Zhang: Does strict invariance matter? Valid group mean comparisons with ordered-categorical items
sources.readScope: Original full publisher HTML self-read in claimed sections: Measurement invariance testing with ordered-categorical items; Observed mean comparison; Factor mean comparison; entire empirical tutorial; entire Discussion and Limitations. Mathematical appendices not fully checked.
sources.limits: Claims limited to threshold-model observed-versus-latent comparisons and identification cautions. Partial scalar invariance is not automatically adequate for observed sum scores; no direct ESS complex-design implementation validated.

sources.provenance: Coordinator supplied dated original HTML path and hash; only this file copied, no reviewer judgement read. Live URL currently reCAPTCHA.
sources.title: Hao Wu and Ryne Estabrook: Identification of Confirmatory Factor Analysis Models of Different Levels of Invariance for Ordered Categorical Outcomes
sources.readScope: Dated original HTML supplied by coordinator, SHA checked before copy; self-read sections 2.2, prose/illustration in section 4, full 5.8, full 6 and full 10. Algebraic derivations/tables are not claimed fully verified.
sources.limits: Live PMC retrieval returned reCAPTCHA; publisher was abstract/subscription. Only the specifically authorized original HTML was read. Paper explicitly excludes partial invariance. Model-specific mathematical identification and binary/three-category equivalences still require review.

sources.title: semTools 0.5-9 manual (14 July 2026)
sources.readScope: compRelSEM pp.18–23: complete arguments, general reliability formula and categorical details; measEq.syntax pp.71–75: full arguments and identification details. Multilevel/higher-order extensions outside claims.
sources.limits: Function expects a lavaan object, not Mplus output. Actual ordinal reliability differs from latent-response reliability. Underlying Green/Yang Eq.21 and unequal-weight extension not verified in primary full texts; body calls Lu et al. 2020 while bibliography needs reconciliation.

sources.title: Samuel B. Green and Yanyun Yang: Reliability of Summed Item Scores Using Structural Equation Modeling: An Alternative to Coefficient Alpha
sources.limits: FULL TEXT UNAVAILABLE: Eq.21 and derivation not self-read; abstract is not procedural verification.

sources.title: Thomas Lumley: Analysis of Complex Survey Samples
sources.readScope: Introduction, section 2.1, section 2.2.1 and initial section 2.2.2, pp.1–5.
sources.limits: Supports design-based ratios/linearization only in read scope; 2004 paper is not current software-version proof or small-domain coverage guarantee.

sources.title: survey 4.5 manual (9 May 2026)
sources.readScope: as.svrepdesign pp.10–11; bootweights pp.14–15; subset.survey.design p.76; surveyoptions pp.77–78; svrepdesign degrees-of-freedom paragraph p.84; svyCprod pp.100–101; svydesign pp.103–106 and svyfactanal details pp.106–107.
sources.limits: Bootstrap warning excludes strict PPS justification. WR ultimate-cluster approximation without fpc is not exact PPS-WOR variance. Domain loneliness and sparse support need separate coverage scrutiny; no runtime found.

sources.title: J. N. K. Rao, C. F. J. Wu and K. Yue: Some recent work on resampling methods for complex surveys
sources.readScope: Scanned original visually read using rendered pages; claims only section 2 pp.210–211 and section 3.3 pp.214–215 equations (3.4)/(3.5) and stated conditions. Pages 209–215 inspected; later simulation/conclusions not fully read.
sources.limits: Complete-response and simplified selection/weight assumptions; not proof of generic ESS PPS bootstrap or recalibration. Text extraction empty, so source was read visually.

sources.title: Erika J. Wolf et al.: Sample Size Requirements for Structural Equation Models: An Evaluation of Power, Bias, and Solution Propriety
sources.readScope: Original Monte Carlo motivation; Data Analysis Overview and Criteria for Evaluating Bias, Power and Solution Propriety; Lesson 3A and Limitations sections.
sources.limits: Original simulation uses normal continuous data and ML, with MCAR missingness scenarios; no transfer of its numeric sample-size results to ordinal weighted clustered ESS models.

sources.title: Shalom H. Schwartz: A Proposal for Measuring Value Orientations across Nations (ESS human values proposal)
sources.readScope: Correcting for Response Tendencies p.17 and Estimation of value orientation scores p.30, full text of these sections.
sources.limits: Relative value priorities require response-tendency handling across values; raw uncentered subset means cannot inherit that claim. No ESS human-values responses or empirical score results read.

claims.claim: ESS recommends anweight and psu/stratum-aware standard errors; single-country pspwght differs by a constant population factor.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P01/P07; conditional approximation and population limitations explicit.

claims.claim: DE historical fieldwork dates and warning against federal-state representativity claims.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P01/P10; no complete design or 4.2 confirmation.

claims.claim: Weighted ordinal WLS estimates and stratum/cluster correction are primary-method supported in the read scope.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P04; no automatic ESS model validity.

claims.claim: WEIGHT supports WLSMV and is not a frequency weight; STRATIFICATION and CLUSTER are documented.
EFA COMPLEX ordinal WLSMV and rotation starts are documented; WLSMV nested comparisons require DIFFTEST rather than simple chi-square subtraction.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P04/P09; no executable smoke or identification proof.

claims.claim: WLS ordinal missing-data conditions are narrower than general outcome-dependent MAR.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P05; neither reference nor user masking is validated by a missing-data estimator.

claims.claim: Categorical WLSMV and current sampling-weight support exist; categorical FIML is not supported by the tutorial.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P04/P05; joint ESS stratification+PSU path remains unproved.

claims.claim: Observed ordinal composites and latent factor means have different invariance requirements; observed-composite interpretation calls for fully strict invariance in the discussed model.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P09; latent or partial-scalar success does not license the exported score.

claims.claim: Identify each invariance model separately; some constraints/models are equivalent and thresholds precede independently testable restrictions.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P09; category-count-specific identification and partial-invariance limitations remain.

claims.claim: measEq.syntax documents Wu.Estabrook.2016 identification and theta/std.lv choices.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P09 software syntax candidate, no full COMPLEX runtime proof.

claims.claim: compRelSEM distinguishes actual ordinal composite reliability from latent-response reliability and accepts composite weights via W syntax.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P06; lavaan object required, mixed continuous/categorical unsupported.

claims.claim: Only existence and abstract-level purpose of the reliability article checked.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P06 primary procedural evidence missing; no Eq.21 claim verified from this abstract.

claims.claim: Survey domain linearization retains design and joint covariance; svydesign without fpc uses WR top-cluster approximation.
Standard survey bootweights are strictly appropriate to SRS/stratified SRS first-stage selection, not PPS.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P07; generic PSU bootstrap deliberately not selected.

claims.claim: Resampling-weight procedures have selection, response and weight-adjustment assumptions.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P07; no unconditional ESS PPS/bootstrap endorsement.

claims.claim: Sample-size calibration should evaluate model-dependent bias, power and solution propriety.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P09; proposed numeric goals are own loss/MC budget, not taken from continuous-ML sample-size results.

claims.claim: Relative value priorities require accounting for response tendencies across the value battery.
claims.scopeAndCounterevidence: P02; possible PVQ scope limit requires separate approval, no items removed.
